arxiv-1902-02309.title: Conformal properties of soft-operators - 1 : Use of null-states
arxiv-1902-02309.creator: Shamik Banerjee, Pranjal Pandey, Partha Paul
arxiv-1902-02309.description: Abstract Soft-operators are (roughly speaking) zero energy massless particles which live on the celestial sphere in Minkowski space. The Lorentz group acts on the celestial sphere by conformal transformation and the soft-operators transform as conformal primary operators of various dimension and spin.

arxiv-2106-14170.title: Fourfold Differential Photoelectron Circular Dichroism
arxiv-2106-14170.creator: K. Fehre, N. M. Novikovskiy, S. Grundmann, G. Kastirke, S. Eckart, F. Trinter, J. Rist, A. Hartung, D. Trabert, C. Janke, G. Nalin, M. Pitzer, S. Zeller, F. Wiegandt, M. Weller, M. Kircher, M. Hofmann, L. Ph. H. Schmidt, A. Knie, A. Hans, L. Ben Ltaief, A. Ehresmann, R. Berger, H. Fukuzawa, K. Ueda,
arxiv-2106-14170.description: Abstract We report on a joint experimental and theoretical study of photoelectron circular dichroism (PECD) in methyloxirane. By detecting O 1s-photoelectrons in coincidence with fragment ions, we deduce the molecule’s orientation and photoelectron emission direction in the laboratory frame. Thereby, we retrieve a fourfold differential PECD clearly beyond 50%.

arxiv-2112-07937.title: The theorems on freedom for relatively free groups with a relations
arxiv-2112-07937.creator: A. F. Krasnikov
arxiv-2112-07937.description: Abstract Introduction The well-known result of Magnus [ 1 ] tells us that if F — a free group on free generators y_{1},\ldots,y_{n} , H — the subgroup of F , generated by y_{1},\ldots,y_{n-1} , 1\neq r\in F , R — the normal subgroup of F generated by r then H\cap R=1 if and only if r is not conjugate

arxiv-2208-12542.title: H4M: Heterogeneous, Multi-source, Multi-modal, Multi-view and Multi-distributional Dataset for Socioeconomic Analytics in the Case of Beijing Thanks: * Corresponding author. This work is supported in part by The National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant No. 71871006), in part by ACCESS –-
arxiv-2208-12542.creator: Yaping Zhao 1,2, Shuhui Shi 1, Ramgopal Ravi 1, Zhongrui Wang 1,2, Edmund Y. Lam 1,2, Jichang Zhao 3,*, 1 The University of Hong Kong, 2 ACCESS–-AI Chip Center for Emerging Smart Systems, 3 Beihang University
arxiv-2208-12542.description: Abstract The study of socioeconomic status has been reformed by the availability of digital records containing data on real estate, points of interest, traffic and social media trends such as micro-blogging. In this paper, we describe a heterogeneous, multi-source, multi-modal, multi-view and multi-distributional dataset named “H4M” .

arxiv-2211-03159.title: Can probability theory really help tame problems in mathematical hydrodynamics?
arxiv-2211-03159.creator: Martina Hofmanová, Florian Bechtold
arxiv-2211-03159.description: Abstract . Recent years have seen spectacular progress in the mathematical study of hydrodynamic equations. Novel tools from convex integration in particular prove extremely versatile in establishing non-uniqueness results. Motivated by this ’pathological’ behavior of solutions in the deterministic setting, stochastic models of fluid dynamics have enjoyed growing interest from the mathematical community.

arxiv-2302-08326.title: NUAA-QMUL-AIIT at Memotion 3: Multi-modal Fusion with Squeeze-and-Excitation for Internet Meme Emotion Analysis
arxiv-2302-08326.creator: Xiaoyu Guo, Jing Ma, Arkaitz Zubiaga
arxiv-2302-08326.description: Abstract This paper describes the participation of our NUAA-QMUL-AIIT team in the Memotion 3 shared task on meme emotion analysis. We propose a novel multi-modal fusion method, Squeeze-and-Excitation Fusion (SEFusion), and embed it into our system for emotion classification in memes. SEFusion is a simple fusion method that employs fully connected layers, reshaping, and matrix multiplication.

arxiv-2305-04372.title: Searching for dark jets with displaced vertices using weakly supervised machine learning
arxiv-2305-04372.creator: Debjyoti Bardhan, Yevgeny Kats, Noam Wunch
arxiv-2305-04372.description: Abstract If “dark quarks” from a confining hidden sector are produced at the LHC, they will shower and hadronize to dark sector hadrons, which may decay back to Standard Model particles within the detector, possibly resulting in a collimated spray of particles resembling a QCD jet.

arxiv-2306-11148.title: From array algebra to energy efficiency on GPUs Conference: ; June 29-30, 2023; Cluj-Napoca, Romania CCS: Theory of computation Lambda calculus
arxiv-2306-11148.creator: Lenore M. R. Mullin
arxiv-2306-11148.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Lenore M. R. Mullin. We present a new formulation for parallel matrix multiplication (MM) to out-perform the standard row-column code design. This algorithm is formulated in the MoA formalism (A Mathematics of Arrays, ( Mullin 1988 ) ( Hains and Mullin 1993 ) ) and combines an array view of hardware ( dimension-lifting to extend indexing to physical memory/processing units), with a contiguous data layout derived from static transformations.

arxiv-2310-15383.title: GD-COMET: A Geo-Diverse Commonsense Inference Model
arxiv-2310-15383.creator: Mehar Bhatia, Vered Shwartz
arxiv-2310-15383.description: Abstract With the increasing integration of AI into everyday life, it’s becoming crucial to design AI systems that serve users from diverse backgrounds by making them culturally aware. In this paper, we present gd-comet , a geo-diverse version of the COMET commonsense inference model.

arxiv-2504-08058.title: Synthesis of actinides and short-lived radionuclides during i-process nucleosynthesis in AGB stars
arxiv-2504-08058.creator: Arthur Choplin, Stephane Goriely, Lionel Siess, Sébastien Martinet
arxiv-2504-08058.description: Abstract Context: A complex interplay between mixing and nucleosynthesis is at work in asymptotic giant branch (AGB) stars. In addition to the slow neutron capture process (s-process), the intermediate neutron capture process (i-process) can develop during protons ingestion events (PIEs).

arxiv-2506-22294.title: Maximal intrinsic randomness of noisy quantum measurements
arxiv-2506-22294.creator: Fionnuala Curran, Morteza Moradi, Gabriel Senno, Magdalena Stobinska, Antonio Acín
arxiv-2506-22294.description: Abstract Quantum physics exhibits an intrinsic and private form of randomness with no classical counterpart. Any setup for quantum randomness generation involves measurements acting on quantum states. In this work, we consider the following question: Given a quantum measurement, how much randomness can be generated from it?

arxiv-2511-06036.title: Towards Human-AI-Robot Collaboration and AI-Agent based Digital Twins for Parkinson’s Disease Management: Review and Outlook
arxiv-2511-06036.creator: Hassan Hizeh, Rim Chighri, Muhammad Mahboob Ur Rahman, Mohamed A. Bahloul, Ali Muqaibel, Tareq Y. Al-Naffouri
arxiv-2511-06036.description: Abstract The current body of research on Parkinson’s disease (PD) screening, monitoring, and management has evolved along two largely independent trajectories. The first research community focuses on multimodal sensing of PD-related biomarkers using noninvasive technologies such as inertial measurement units (IMUs), force/pressure insoles, electromyography (EMG), electroencephalography (EEG), speech and acoustic analysis, and RGB/RGB-D motion capture systems.

arxiv-2511-21224.title: A p p -adaptive high-order mesh-free framework for fluid simulations in complex geometries
arxiv-2511-21224.creator: Ruofeng Feng, Jack R. C. King, Steven J. Lind
arxiv-2511-21224.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel p p -adaptive, high-order mesh-free framework for the accurate and efficient simulation of fluid flows in complex geometries. High-order differential operators are constructed locally for arbitrary node distributions using linear combinations of anisotropic basis functions, formulated to ensure the exact reproduction of polynomial fields up to the specified p p order.

arxiv-2601-22225.title: Modified Teleparallel f ⁡ ( T ) f(T) Gravity, DESI BAO and the H 0 H_{0} Tension
arxiv-2601-22225.creator: Mariam Bouhmadi-López, Carlos G. Boiza, Maria Petronikolou, Emmanuel N. Saridakis
arxiv-2601-22225.description: Abstract We investigate whether late-time modifications of gravity in the teleparallel framework can impact the current tension in the Hubble constant H 0 H_{0} , focusing on f ⁡ ( T ) f(T) cosmology as a minimal and well-controlled extension of General Relativity.

blackwood-wendigo-1910.title: The Wendigo
blackwood-wendigo-1910.creator: Algernon Blackwood
blackwood-wendigo-1910.description: The 1910 Canadian wilderness novella of the Wendigo, the definitive literary treatment of the North Woods monster.

britannica-1911-micronucleus.title: Micronucleus (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-micronucleus.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-micronucleus.description: Article 'Micronucleus' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. In fission it divides by mitosis, and in conjugation furnishes the pairing or gametonuclei, by whose reciprocal fusion a zygote-nucleus is formed, which gives rise to the meganuclei and micronuclei of the individuals of the next cycle of fission.

pmc-10629975.title: Lead management in patients undergoing percutaneous tricuspid valve replacement or repair: a ‘heart team’ approach
pmc-10629975.creator: James K Gabriels, Robert D Schaller, Elana Koss, Bruce J Rutkin, Roger G Carrillo, Laurence M Epstein
pmc-10629975.description: Clinically significant tricuspid regurgitation (TR) has historically been managed with either medical therapy or surgical interventions. More recently, percutaneous trans-catheter tricuspid valve (TV) replacement and tricuspid trans-catheter edge-to-edge repair have emerged as alternative treatment modalities. Patients with cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs) have an increased incidence of TR.

pmc-10658535.title: Risk factors, treatment, and outcome in dogs and cats with subdural hematoma and hemispheric collapse after ventriculoperitoneal shunting of congenital internal hydrocephalus
pmc-10658535.creator: Daniela Farke, Anna K Siwicka, Agnieszka Olszewska, Adriana Czerwik, Kathrin Büttner, Martin J Schmidt
pmc-10658535.description: BackgroundOvershunting and hemispheric collapse are well‐known complications after ventriculoperitoneal shunt (VPS) implantation. Risk factors that predispose to overshunting, treatment options, and prognosis after therapeutic intervention have not been described.Hypothesis/ObjectivesTo identify preoperative risk factors for overshunting, the effect of surgical decompression, and their outcomes.AnimalsSeventy‐five dogs and 7 cats.MethodsRetrospective case cohort study.

pmc-11454125.title: 8414 Utilization Of Cell Free DNA Integrity Index To Differentiate Benign From Malignant Thyroid Nodules
pmc-11454125.creator: S Tarafdar, S Dutta, P Mukhopadhyay, N P Bhattacharya, S Ghosh
pmc-11454125.description: Disclosure: S. Tarafdar: None. S. Dutta: None. P. Mukhopadhyay: None. N.P. Bhattacharya: None. S. Ghosh: None. Introduction: Recent advances in molecular genetics have evaluated a potential role for plasma cell-free DNA (cfDNA) integrity index as a non-invasive cancer marker. Data on cfDNA integrity in differentiated thyroid cancer is sparse and needs to be investigated further.

pmc-11710685.title: Gait Speed as a Marker of Superior Physical Performance in SuperAgers: Cognitive and Neuroanatomical Correlates
pmc-11710685.creator: Bori. R. Kim, Kee Hyung Park, Jee Hyang Jeong, Geon Ha Kim
pmc-11710685.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundCognitive abilities, notably memory, typically decline with age, but a subset of individuals known as superagers defy this trend by exhibiting memory functions akin to those 20‐30 years younger in late life.

pmc-12906885.title: A Rare Foot Duplication; Mirror Foot - Case Report
pmc-12906885.creator: Ibrahim Akpinar, Murat Dogus Cerikan, Omer Faruk Dilek
pmc-12906885.description: Polydactyly is a congenital extremity malformation defined by the presence of additional digits. The mirror foot anomaly, regarded as a rare variant of preaxial polydactyly, is characterized by a mirror image duplication of the foot. Due to the variability of mirror foot patterns reported in the literature, defining the term “mirror foot” remains challenging.

pmc-13061354.title: Care, Discipline, and the Politics of Visibility in Allied Surgical Histories, 1870–1945
pmc-13061354.creator: Jennifer Dunn
pmc-13061354.description: Allied operating theaters between 1870 and 1945 were sites of surgical innovation and military urgency. This study argues that they functioned as infrastructures of power. It reconceptualizes the operating theater as an ideological formation where authority is spatially choreographed, emotional discipline institutionalized, and professional legitimacy unevenly distributed.

pmc-13227109.title: Conformational gating governs nucleotide incorporation by a DNA-crosslinked polymerase
pmc-13227109.creator: Daniel Betancourt, Amit Gaur, Turner W Seay, Nikita Zalenski, Zucai Suo
pmc-13227109.description: Base excision repair is a major pathway that repairs single-base DNA damage. We recently demonstrated that human DNA polymerase β (hPolβ) fills single-nucleotide gaps after Schiff base formation but before β-elimination, implying that its dRP lyase domain remains covalently crosslinked to DNA during gap-filling synthesis. Because uncrosslinked Polβ dissociates rapidly from DNA (∼3 s−1), mechanistic investigation has been challenging.

pmc-13262511.title: Demographic prompt cues shift clinical recommendations in multimodal large language models: a multi-model audit of 25,380 dental radiograph assessments
pmc-13262511.creator: Babak Saravi, Ingrid Winkler, Daman Deep Singh, Julian Lommen, Max Wilkat, Lara Schorn, Andreas Vollmer, Michael Vollmer, Norbert Kübler, Christoph Sproll, Felix Schrader
pmc-13262511.description: BackgroundMultimodal large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being evaluated for clinical image interpretation, but whether patient demographic cues influence their recommendations remains unclear in dental radiology—a leading domain for AI-assisted diagnostics, and one marked by pronounced disparities in oral health.MethodsWe conducted a within-image, between-condition audit study using 705 panoramic dental radiographs from the publicly available DENTEX dataset.

pmc-13323506.title: Impact of preoperative skeletal muscle mass on the healing time of postoperative pancreatic fistula after pancreaticoduodenectomy
pmc-13323506.creator: Takuro Takeuchi, Yoshito Tomimaru, Hirofumi Akita, Yosuke Mukai, Kazuki Sasaki, Shinichiro Hasegawa, Daisaku Yamada, Takehiro Noda, Yuichiro Doki, Hidetoshi Eguchi
pmc-13323506.description: BackgroundPostoperative pancreatic fistula (POPF) is a serious complication following pancreaticoduodenectomy (PD). While numerous studies have investigated POPF incidence and risk factors, few have focused on POPF healing time (POPF-HT). Skeletal muscle mass has been increasingly recognized as an endocrine organ involved in interorgan communication.

pmc-13345296.title: Optimizing treatment for depressed parents of children with emotional and behavioral disorders: A multi-site feasibility trial
pmc-13345296.creator: Brendan F. Andrade, Sabrina Brodkin, Aliza Israel, Tatiana Valverde da Conceicao, Madison Aitken, Tatiana Djurovic, Marco Battaglia, Anne-Claude Bedard, Anjali Suri, Darren Courtney, Hali Kil, Stefan Kloiber, Judith M. Laposa, Clement Ma, Simone N. Vigod, Peter Szatmari
pmc-13345296.description: BackgroundBehavioral parent training (BPT) programs are effective for reducing disruptive behavior of many children with emotional and behavioral disorders (EBD) and improving skills and competencies of their parents. However, these interventions are not sufficiently effective for parents who themselves have depression.
